suppress.notes: CVE-2026-66299 affects the Apache Tomcat WebSocket chat example application because it uses an unbounded buffer for undelivered messages. Dokene uses Spring Boot's embedded Tomcat and does not package or deploy Tomcat's examples web application. Apache explicitly states that users without the examples web application are not affected. Remove this suppression once Spring Boot manages Tomcat 11.0.25 or later.
